scenarios.label: Reserve a concert seat
scenarios.requirement: Confirm one available seat without double-selling it; notify the buyer after the durable reservation succeeds.
scenarios.invariant: A seat may be confirmed at most once for the same show.

components.commit-first: API -> reservation service -> transactional store -> outbox -> notification worker
components.async-first: API -> queue -> worker -> transactional store -> notification worker
components.transactional-store: Transactional reservation store with a unique show-and-seat constraint
components.outbox-queue: Transactional outbox plus durable queue for notifications

scenarios.label: Show a courier location
scenarios.requirement: Serve a recent location quickly; a delayed point may be acceptable if it is visibly stale.
scenarios.invariant: A location update cannot be attributed to a different delivery.

components.commit-first: API -> location service -> event log -> materialized location view
components.async-first: Courier -> durable event stream -> location consumer -> cached customer view
components.event-log: Append-only location event stream keyed by delivery ID
components.cache: Read-through cache with the last-update timestamp
